title: GTA 6 PS5 Physical Edition Includes a Poster, But It's Still Not the Map
summary: Two-sided A3 poster in the PS5 case
text: GTA 6 PS5 Physical Edition Includes a Poster, But It's Still Not the Map | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA GTA 6 PS5 Physical Edition Includes a Poster, But It's Still Not the Map Two-sided A3 poster in the PS5 case by Liam Croft 10 mins ago Share: Retailers are beginning the process of shipping out their boxed copies of GTA 6 , which include a digital download code instead of a physical disc. As they receive their stock, it's now been confirmed there is actually a poster inside the case. However, it's still not the map of the game world previous GTA games have shipped with. UK retailer The Game Collection has been able to confirm there's a double-sided A3 poster included in the case, as it plans to ship boxed versions later this week. Those who do get the physical version can start preloading the digital edition ready for release on 19th November 2026. With physical copies now out in the wild, the contents have been posted online, and the poster included has the GTA 6 key art on one side, and the cover girl on the other: First look at GTA 6’s physical copies and their contents. The game includes a double-sided poster featuring the cover art and cover girl artwork. (via MediaMarktSaturn) pic.twitter.com/cEVvDTernb - GTA 6 Info (@GTASixInfo) November 7, 2026 Related Articles News GTA 6's PS5 Physical Edition Revealed in First Photo Code-in-box Guide GTA 6 Release Times and Preload: When Can You Start Playing? All the GTA 6 release info you need If you want that physical map of the GTA 6 open world, then you'll need to wait until after release. Rockstar has revealed a map poster will be available from its official online store. It's $0.99 if you just want to buy it, or it'll be included free of charge with a purchase of anything else on the storefront. Preload of GTA 6 will be going live worldwide within the next 24 hours, allowing you to download its 212GB of data well ahead of time. Refer to our GTA 6 Release Times and Preload guide for more information, with the PS5 launch scheduled for 19th November 2026.
